summary: Registered a successor execution that removes the remaining synthesis caveat on the vote path by letting the target produce the campaign itself. The harness's new stale_campaign_wins case has one peer snapshot itself while it is still a voter, has its vote removed in the committed configuration, and then restarts only that peer and one other instance while the former leader stays down. Local verification before submission: with the flag enabled the peer reconstructed three voters from its own snapshot while its log's committed configuration has two and grants it no vote, campaigned on its own — the other instance observed one pre-vote and one real vote request from it — was answered by that instance whose own reconstruction was empty, and became Leader; with the flag disabled it reconstructed the committed configuration, holds no vote there, never campaigned and stayed Follower. Three comparisons are declared: a peer without a vote in its own committed configuration must not acquire leadership (predicted violated for the flag-enabled case, holding for the control) and a predicate recording that the real vote request reached the other instance. Validation reports a valid update with one experiment created and an execution requested. Incomplete: the receipt is outstanding, so no interpretation was recorded this turn, and the two earlier syntheses (the delivered vote request in the previous case and the extra election needed for the discard) remain documented in the current account's limitations.
